text_to_speech: do you use cam strap tie down straps to tie down your gear like I do they can get very messy how do you go from this to this here's a trick to organize your straps fold the strap in half and feed the end through the bottom of the Buckle leaving a tail hanging out roll the strap all the way up until it meets the buckle now wrap the tail around and feed it through the cam lock on the buckle I learned this trick when I was a raft guide because Rafters use a lot of Cam straps to tie down everything now your straps are nice and neatly organized and ready to be used

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Do you use cam strap tied down straps to tie down your gear like I do?
They can get very messy. How do you go from this to this?
Here's a trick to organize your straps. Fold the strap in half and feed the end through the bottom of the buckle, leaving a tail hanging out.
Now roll the strap all the way up until it meets the buckle.
Now wrap the tail around and feed it through the cam lock on the buckle.
I learned this trick when I was a raft guide because rafters use a lot of cam straps to tie down everything.
Now your straps are nice and neatly organized and ready to be used.
